args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended)
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Beach towel
- Flip flops/Beach sandals
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and rocky beaches)

Clothing:
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket or small umbrella (for occasional showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Formal outfit (optional, for nice dinners)

Electronics:
- Camera with waterproof case
- Phone with waterproof case
- Chargers for all devices
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

Travel Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication (if needed for boat trips)
- Insect repellent
- Toiletries
- Hand sanitizer

Activity-Specific Items:
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - though can be rented)
- Waterproof bag for beach days
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader for relaxation
- Travel guide for Hawaii
- Snacks for day trips
- Reusable shopping bags
